module_metadata.purpose: Default Jolt Physics 3D (4.6/4.7), CollisionShape2D.one_way_collision_direction (4.7), chunked TileMapLayer physics, melee AttackArea radius math rule, and PhysicsDirectSpaceState queries.

jolt_physics_3d_default.status: Default 3D physics engine for all new projects in Godot 4.6 and 4.7.
guardrails: Keep dynamic RigidBody3D dimensions between 0.1m and 10m for stable solver convergence.
Use uniform scaling (scale.x == scale.y == scale.z) on Node3D parents of CollisionShape3D.
Use AnimatableBody3D (with sync_to_physics = true) for moving platforms.

one_way_collision_direction_4_7_new.description: NEW in Godot 4.7: Allows setting any arbitrary 2D unit vector for one-way pass-through collisions without rotating the CollisionShape2D node.

chunked_tilemaplayer_physics_4_5_plus.description: TileMapLayer automatically merges adjacent tile collision polygons into chunked shapes at runtime, eliminating internal edge snagging and reducing broadphase overhead.

melee_attack_area_radius_math_rule.problem: When two solid `CharacterBody2D` or `StaticBody2D` nodes collide, their centers can never get closer than `Attacker_Body_Radius + Target_Body_Radius` (or half-extents). If an attacker's `AttackArea` (`Area2D`) radius is smaller than or equal to the sum of their solid collision radii, `AttackArea` will NEVER overlap the target!
melee_attack_area_radius_math_rule.formula: AttackArea_Radius >= Attacker_Solid_Radius + Target_Solid_Radius + 6.0 (safety margin in pixels)
melee_attack_area_radius_math_rule.example: If Zombie solid CircleShape2D radius = 14.0 px and Player solid CircleShape2D radius = 16.0 px, minimum center distance on contact is 30.0 px. Therefore, Zombie's `AttackArea` CircleShape2D radius MUST be >= 36.0 px (e.g., 38.0 px) to reliably detect contact!

collision_callback_safety.rule: NEVER mutate `CollisionShape2D.disabled` directly inside `body_entered`, `body_exited`, `area_entered`, or damage callbacks triggered during physics step.
